verdict.rationale: The story accepts built-in collaboration as one route, and PlayCanvas documents it directly. Its browser-based Editor lets multiple developers, artists and designers build the same scene at the same time with no merge conflicts. Checkpoints provide project snapshots and rollback, plans include unlimited public teammates, and scripts can be edited locally via the VS Code extension and playcanvas-sync. Community users note you cannot easily use your own source control and that code lives on PlayCanvas servers, which limits the external version-control side. missing for 10: diffable/mergeable text scene formats or git integration, documented branching/merging workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of real-time collaboration.
